name: PdfPrint
caption: Create PDF

configuration.description: Record selector: a SmartField placeholder in {{name}} notation that points to a record reference (e.g. {{trigger_Rec}}). The report runs filtered to exactly that record (SetRecFilter). Leave empty for reports without a data-source record (e.g. financial reports). Bare names without braces are rejected.
Report object ID, stored as a decimal integer in a JSON string (e.g. "1306"). Empty means no report picked.

Report request-page parameters as XML (the string Business Central's RunRequestPage produces). SmartField placeholders ({{...}}) inside the XML are resolved at run time. Legacy flows stored this value base64-encoded; a value that does not start with '<' (after leading whitespace) is treated as base64 and decoded. Empty = report defaults.
Name of a report layout defined for the selected report (as listed in Report Layouts). Empty = the report's default layout. Only applies to this one render.

ID of the app that owns the layout, as a GUID string without braces. Disambiguates layouts with the same name from different apps. Re-derived from (report, layout) every time the step is saved in the editor; empty or unparsable = match the layout by name only.

File name for the generated document. Built-in tokens {ReportName}, {RecordNo}, {ReportId} are replaced; SmartFields ({{...}}) are resolved too. Include the .pdf extension yourself. Empty = 'Report_<reportId>.pdf'. The stored document name is truncated to 250 characters.

notes: The enum caption is 'Create PDF Document'; the step picker shows 'Create PDF'. Default step description is 'Create <report caption> PDF'.
No publish-time check exists for this step; selector/report/layout problems surface at run time. The dialog only requires a report to be picked.
The output 'Document' is a reference to an AutoFlow Document record (table 5564415: ID, Name, Content Type, Length, Data).
{RecordNo} is the primary-key value(s) of the selector record joined with '_' (empty when there is no selector).
The layout picker in the editor is read-only and lookup-only; on Business Central 24 no lookup page is available, so the layout can only be set by editing the JSON.
Word and RDLC layouts render to PDF directly; Excel/custom layouts may produce varying results.
